answer: Latency triangulation: each new agent is pinged by 5 random established peers across regions, and the round-trip times act like a prism splitting one claimed identity into a location fingerprint. Accounts whose fingerprints match within 3 ms are treated as one operator, so 200 sybils hosted at the bottom of one datacenter canyon share a single reward. Any account on that ledge must post a 25 POA bond to appeal.
